points.title: 王子教育
points.description: 亚历山大约公元前356年生于马其顿王国首都佩拉，是腓力二世和奥林匹娅斯之子。童年时期，他由著名哲学家亚里士多德担任私人教师，接受了包括哲学、科学、文学和医学在内的全面教育。这段教育塑造了亚历山大对知识的热爱和对希腊文化的深刻理解，同时也培养了他的军事才能和领导力。亚里士多德教导他荷马史诗，激发了他对东方探险的向往，这对他后来的征服事业产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Alexander was born around 356 BC in Pella, the capital of the Kingdom of Macedon, as the son of Philip II and Olympias. During his childhood, he was tutored by the famous philosopher Aristotle, receiving a comprehensive education in philosophy, science, literature, and medicine. This education shaped Alexander's love for knowledge and deep understanding of Greek culture, while also developing his military skills and leadership abilities. Aristotle taught him Homer's epics, sparking his fascination with Eastern exploration that profoundly influenced his later conquests.

points.title: 继位准备
points.description: 公元前340年，16岁的亚历山大被任命为摄政王，在腓力二世远征拜占庭期间统治马其顿。他成功镇压了马其顿北部的部落起义，展示了其军事才能。公元前338年，他在喀罗尼亚战役中指挥马其顿左翼骑兵，对腓力二世战胜希腊城邦联军起到了关键作用。然而，他与父亲的关系紧张，特别是在腓力二世与克利奥帕特拉·欧里狄丝结婚后，亚历山大一度与母亲奥林匹娅斯一同被流放。这些经历锻炼了他的政治智慧和军事才能，为他后来的统治奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 340 BC, at age 16, Alexander was appointed regent of Macedon while Philip II was away on campaign against Byzantium. He successfully suppressed tribal uprisings in northern Macedon, demonstrating his military abilities. In 338 BC, he commanded the left wing cavalry at the Battle of Chaeronea, playing a crucial role in Philip's victory over the Greek city-states. However, his relationship with his father was strained, especially after Philip's marriage to Cleopatra Eurydice, which led to Alexander and his mother Olympias being temporarily exiled. These experiences honed his political wisdom and military skills, laying the foundation for his later reign.

points.title: 权力巩固
points.description: 公元前336年，腓力二世遇刺后，20岁的亚历山大迅速登上马其顿王位。他首先处决了潜在的竞争对手，巩固了权力。随后，他南下希腊，在科林斯召开泛希腊会议，被推举为希腊联军统帅，准备东征波斯。亚历山大通过军事威慑和外交手段相结合的方式，成功镇压了底比斯的起义，并摧毁了这座城市作为警告。这一时期，他展现了卓越的政治手腕和军事才能，既保持了希腊各城邦的表面服从，又为东征做好了充分准备。
points.descriptionEn: In 336 BC, after Philip II's assassination, the 20-year-old Alexander ascended to the Macedonian throne. He first executed potential rivals to consolidate his power. Then he marched south to Greece, where at the Congress of Corinth he was elected commander of the Greek alliance, preparing for the expedition against Persia. Alexander combined military deterrence with diplomatic skill, successfully suppressing the uprising in Thebes and destroying the city as a warning. During this period, he demonstrated exceptional political acumen and military ability, maintaining nominal submission from Greek city-states while thoroughly preparing for the eastern campaign.

points.title: 东征开始
points.description: 公元前334年，亚历山大率领约3万步兵和5千骑兵渡过达达尼尔海峡，开始东征波斯。在格拉尼库斯河战役中，他率领马其顿骑兵冲锋，击败了波斯总督们率领的军队，展现了非凡的军事才能。随后，他解放了爱奥尼亚地区的希腊城邦，赢得了当地居民的支持。在戈尔迪乌姆之结的传说中，他用剑斩断了这个被认为无法解开的结，象征性地表明他将用非常规方式解决东方问题。这一阶段的胜利不仅为东征奠定了基础，也展示了亚历山大作为军事统帅的非凡才能和决断力。
points.descriptionEn: In 334 BC, Alexander crossed the Dardanelles with an army of about 30,000 infantry and 5,000 cavalry, beginning his campaign against Persia. At the Battle of the Granicus River, he led a cavalry charge that defeated the army of Persian satraps, demonstrating extraordinary military skill. He then liberated the Greek cities of Ionia, winning support from the local population. In the legend of the Gordian Knot, he cut through the knot with his sword, symbolically indicating he would solve Eastern problems through unconventional means. The victories of this phase not only laid the foundation for the eastern campaign but also showcased Alexander's exceptional military talent and decisiveness as a commander.

points.title: 关键胜利
points.description: 公元前333年，亚历山大在伊苏斯战役中击败了大流士三世率领的波斯主力军，俘虏了波斯国王的家眷。这一胜利使亚历山大控制了整个叙利亚地区。随后，他向南进军埃及，被当地人视为解放者而受到欢迎。在埃及，他建立了亚历山大城，这座后来成为地中海世界最伟大的文化中心之一的城市。他在西瓦绿洲被宣布为阿蒙神之子，获得了法老的合法性。这一时期，亚历山大开始融合希腊与东方文化，他采用波斯服饰和礼仪，尝试建立东西方融合的统治模式，这体现了他作为征服者的远见卓识。
points.descriptionEn: In 333 BC, Alexander defeated the main Persian army led by Darius III at the Battle of Issus, capturing the Persian king's family. This victory gave Alexander control over all of Syria. He then marched south into Egypt, where he was welcomed as a liberator. In Egypt, he founded Alexandria, which would become one of the greatest cultural centers in the Mediterranean world. At the Siwa Oasis, he was declared the son of Ammon and gained legitimacy as a pharaoh. During this period, Alexander began to blend Greek and Eastern cultures, adopting Persian dress and court etiquette, attempting to create a ruling model that fused Eastern and Western elements, demonstrating his visionary approach as a conqueror.

points.title: 帝国巅峰
points.description: 公元前331年，亚历山大在高加米拉战役中彻底击败大流士三世，随后占领巴比伦、苏萨和波斯波利斯等波斯帝国首都。他继续向东征服，到达中亚和印度河流域。在印度，他遇到了强大的波鲁斯王国，并在海达斯佩斯战役中取得胜利，但因士兵疲惫和思乡而被迫停止东进。返回途中，他在苏萨举行集体婚礼，试图将马其顿贵族与波斯贵族联姻，促进文化融合。公元前323年，在巴比伦，32岁的亚历山大突然发烧去世，留下一个从希腊延伸至印度的庞大帝国。他的征服促进了东西方文化交流，开启了希腊化时代。
points.descriptionEn: In 331 BC, Alexander completely defeated Darius III at the Battle of Gaugamela, subsequently capturing the Persian capitals of Babylon, Susa, and Persepolis. He continued his conquests eastward, reaching Central Asia and the Indus Valley. In India, he encountered the powerful kingdom of Porus and won the Battle of the Hydaspes, but was forced to stop further advances due to exhausted troops and homesickness. On his return, he held mass weddings at Susa, attempting to marry Macedonian nobles to Persian aristocrats to promote cultural fusion. In 323 BC, at age 32, Alexander suddenly died of fever in Babylon, leaving behind a vast empire stretching from Greece to India. His conquests facilitated cultural exchange between East and West, inaugurating the Hellenistic era.

supporter.zh: 亚历山大大帝被视为历史上最伟大的军事领袖和文明传播者之一。他不仅征服了当时已知的世界，更促进了希腊文化与东方文明的融合，开启了希腊化时代。他尊重被征服地区的文化，鼓励不同民族间的通婚与交流，建立了数十座以他名字命名的城市，成为文化传播的枢纽。亚历山大的远见卓识和包容精神，使他超越了单纯的征服者，成为东西方文明交流的桥梁，对后世产生了深远影响。
supporter.en: Alexander the Great is regarded as one of history's greatest military leaders and civilizational disseminators. He not only conquered the known world of his time but also facilitated the fusion of Greek and Eastern civilizations, inaugurating the Hellenistic era. He respected the cultures of conquered regions, encouraged intermarriage and exchange among different peoples, and founded numerous cities bearing his name that became centers of cultural transmission. Alexander's vision and inclusivity transcended mere conquest, making him a bridge between Eastern and Western civilizations with profound influence on posterity.

critic.zh: 批评者认为亚历山大的征服造成了巨大的人员伤亡和文明破坏。他的东征导致无数城市被毁，无数生命消逝，如底比斯的毁灭和波斯王都的洗劫。亚历山大的统治方式也充满矛盾，一方面宣扬希腊文化优越性，另一方面又采用东方专制统治模式。他的帝国缺乏稳固的统治基础，主要依靠个人魅力和军事力量维持，导致他死后帝国迅速分裂。此外，他对个人荣誉的过度追求和对东方财富的贪婪，也被视为其统治的阴暗面。
critic.en: Critics argue that Alexander's conquests caused massive casualties and cultural destruction. His eastern campaigns led to the destruction of numerous cities and the loss of countless lives, such as the sacking of Thebes and the Persian capitals. Alexander's rule was contradictory—promoting Greek cultural superiority while adopting Eastern autocratic practices. His empire lacked a stable foundation, relying primarily on personal charisma and military force, leading to its rapid fragmentation after his death. Additionally, his excessive pursuit of personal glory and greed for Eastern wealth are seen as darker aspects of his rule.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，亚历山大大帝被复杂地定义为既是军事天才又是文化融合的象征。他被视为古代世界最伟大的征服者之一，其军事创新如方阵战术的运用和骑兵冲锋的战术，影响了后世军事发展。同时，他作为希腊化时代的开创者，促进了东西方文化交流，亚历山大城成为学术中心，图书馆和博物馆的建立影响了后世学术传统。在流行文化中，亚历山大常被浪漫化为年轻的理想主义英雄，但也被视为权力与野心的象征，反映了人类对征服与文明传播的永恒矛盾态度。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Alexander the Great is complexly defined as both a military genius and a symbol of cultural fusion. He is regarded as one of the greatest conquerors of the ancient world, with his military innovations such as the use of phalanx tactics and cavalry charges influencing later military development. Simultaneously, as the founder of the Hellenistic era, he facilitated cultural exchange between East and West, with Alexandria becoming an academic center whose libraries and museums influenced later scholarly traditions. In popular culture, Alexander is often romanticized as a young idealistic hero but also seen as a symbol of power and ambition, reflecting humanity's ambivalent attitude toward conquest and civilizational transmission.

self.zh: 我若不是亚历山大，我愿做第欧根尼。
self.en: If I were not Alexander, I would be Diogenes.

others.zh: 亚历山大是一位伟大的国王，但他也是一位悲剧人物，因为他没有留下一个能够继承他事业的儿子。
others.en: Alexander was a great king, but he was also a tragic figure because he left no son capable of continuing his work.
